title: Design System: PopEngine Riso Field Guide

display.purpose: Product marks, cover titles, and the organizer overview.

label.purpose: Provenance, statuses, navigation chapters, and stamps.

shadows.name: ink-registration
shadows.purpose: Primary actions, verdict bands, and strong active states.

shadows.name: blue-plate-offset
shadows.purpose: Quieter paper cards and regulatory units.

shadows.name: pressed-registration
shadows.purpose: Pressed and hover states paired with a two-pixel translation.

motion.name: state-fast
motion.purpose: Color, border, and registration-offset changes on controls.

motion.name: reduced-motion
motion.purpose: Removes optional transitions and movement when requested.

components.name: Primary Button
components.description: The coral call to action with a hard ink registration offset.
components.css: .ds-button-primary { display: inline-flex; min-height: 2.8rem; align-items: center; justify-content: center; padding: 0.68rem 1rem; border: 2px solid var(--pe-ink); border-radius: var(--pe-radius); color: var(--pe-cream-text); background: var(--pe-coral); font-family: var(--pe-font-body); font-size: 0.9rem; font-weight: 800; box-shadow: 4px 4px 0 var(--pe-ink); cursor: pointer; transition: background 160ms ease, box-shadow 160ms ease, transform 160ms ease; } .ds-button-primary:hover { background: var(--pe-blue); box-shadow: 2px 2px 0 var(--pe-ink); transform: translate(2px, 2px); } .ds-button-primary:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid var(--pe-yellow); outline-offset: 3px; } .ds-button-primary:active { box-shadow: 1px 1px 0 var(--pe-ink); transform: translate(3px, 3px); }

components.name: Secondary Button
components.description: A paper action for supporting or reversible tasks.
components.css: .ds-button-secondary { display: inline-flex; min-height: 2.75rem; align-items: center; justify-content: center; padding: 0.55rem 1rem; border: 1.5px solid var(--pe-ink); border-radius: var(--pe-radius); color: var(--pe-ink); background: var(--pe-card); font-family: var(--pe-font-body); font-size: 0.9rem; font-weight: 700; cursor: pointer; transition: background 160ms ease, border-color 160ms ease; } .ds-button-secondary:hover { border-color: var(--pe-coral); background: var(--pe-paper-deep); } .ds-button-secondary:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid var(--pe-yellow); outline-offset: 3px; } .ds-button-secondary:active { background: var(--pe-surface); }

components.name: Text Field
components.description: A square paper field with an explicit label and signal-color focus.
components.css: .ds-field { display: grid; gap: 0.4rem; color: var(--pe-ink); font-family: var(--pe-font-body); } .ds-field > span { font-family: var(--pe-font-mono); font-size: 0.68rem; font-weight: 600; letter-spacing: 0.12em; text-transform: uppercase; } .ds-field input { min-height: 2.85rem; padding: 0.7rem 0.8rem; border: 1.5px solid var(--pe-rule); border-radius: var(--pe-radius); color: var(--pe-ink); background: var(--pe-surface); font: inherit; transition: border-color 160ms ease, background 160ms ease; } .ds-field input:hover { border-color: var(--pe-coral); background: var(--pe-card); } .ds-field input:focus-visible { border-color: var(--pe-coral); outline: 3px solid var(--pe-yellow); outline-offset: 3px; }

components.name: Active Lifecycle Link
components.description: The current organizer route in the federal-blue lifecycle rail.
components.html: PERMIT PLAN
components.css: .ds-nav { width: 14rem; padding: 0.8rem; color: var(--pe-cream-text); background: var(--pe-blue); font-family: var(--pe-font-body); } .ds-nav a { display: flex; min-height: 2.75rem; align-items: center; padding: 0.48rem 0.62rem; border: 1px solid var(--pe-ink); color: var(--pe-ink); background: var(--pe-yellow); font-size: 0.85rem; font-weight: 800; text-decoration: none; box-shadow: 3px 3px 0 var(--pe-ink); } .ds-nav a:hover { background: var(--pe-paper); } .ds-nav a:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid var(--pe-yellow); outline-offset: 3px; } .ds-nav a:active { box-shadow: 1px 1px 0 var(--pe-ink); transform: translate(2px, 2px); }

components.name: Planned Module Insert
components.description: A visibly provisional disabled module on clipped field-guide paper.
components.css: .ds-planned { width: 14rem; padding: 1rem 1.25rem; border: 1.5px solid var(--pe-ink); color: var(--pe-blue); background: var(--pe-paper); font-family: var(--pe-font-body); box-shadow: 4px 5px 0 var(--pe-coral); clip-path: polygon(1% 2%, 96% 0, 100% 96%, 4% 100%, 0 48%); transform: rotate(-0.8deg); } .ds-planned > strong { font-family: var(--pe-font-mono); font-size: 0.68rem; letter-spacing: 0.18em; } .ds-planned button { display: flex; width: 100%; min-height: 2.75rem; align-items: center; justify-content: space-between; padding: 0.48rem 0; border: 0; color: rgba(22, 63, 140, 0.57); background: transparent; font: inherit; cursor: not-allowed; } .ds-planned button span { padding: 0.12rem 0.3rem; border: 1px solid currentColor; font-family: var(--pe-font-mono); font-size: 0.68rem; letter-spacing: 0.08em; } .ds-planned button:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid var(--pe-yellow); outline-offset: 3px; }

components.name: Task Card
components.description: A discrete next-task unit used in the event field-guide overview.
components.html: OPEN PERMIT PLANReview the engine-generated verdict, findings, provenance, and coverage notices.
components.css: .ds-task-card { display: grid; gap: 0.25rem; min-height: 4.5rem; padding: 0.8rem 0.9rem; border: 1.5px solid var(--pe-ink); color: var(--pe-ink); background: var(--pe-card); font-family: var(--pe-font-body); text-decoration: none; box-shadow: 3px 3px 0 rgba(22, 63, 140, 0.2); transition: color 160ms ease, background 160ms ease, box-shadow 160ms ease; } .ds-task-card strong { font-family: var(--pe-font-display); font-size: 1.25rem; line-height: 1; } .ds-task-card small { color: var(--pe-steel); line-height: 1.4; } .ds-task-card:hover { color: var(--pe-cream-text); background: var(--pe-blue); box-shadow: 3px 3px 0 var(--pe-coral); } .ds-task-card:hover small { color: inherit; } .ds-task-card:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid var(--pe-yellow); outline-offset: 3px; } .ds-task-card:active { box-shadow: 1px 1px 0 var(--pe-coral); transform: translate(2px, 2px); }

components.name: At-Risk Verdict Band
components.description: An engine-derived at-risk result with high-contrast registration treatment.
components.css: .ds-verdict { margin: 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 2px solid var(--pe-ink); border-radius: var(--pe-radius); color: var(--pe-ink); background: var(--pe-yellow); font-family: var(--pe-font-body); line-height: 1.55; box-shadow: 4px 4px 0 var(--pe-ink); } .ds-verdict:hover { box-shadow: 3px 3px 0 var(--pe-ink); } .ds-verdict:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid var(--pe-yellow); outline-offset: 3px; }

components.name: Provenance Snapshot
components.description: Compact source metadata for the ruleset pinned to a permit plan.
components.css: .ds-snapshot { margin: 0; padding: 0.7rem 0.95rem; border: 1.5px solid var(--pe-blue); border-radius: var(--pe-radius); color: var(--pe-steel); background: var(--pe-surface); font-family: var(--pe-font-mono); font-size: 0.84rem; box-shadow: 3px 3px 0 rgba(22, 63, 140, 0.18); } .ds-snapshot strong { color: var(--pe-ink); } .ds-snapshot:hover { background: var(--pe-card); } .ds-snapshot:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid var(--pe-yellow); outline-offset: 3px; }

narrative.overview:
PopEngine feels like a practical printed manual assembled for work in the field. Federal blue, signal coral, registration yellow, real paper grain, condensed type, hard rules, and deliberately offset ink marks create an ownable visual world without compromising the clarity expected of an operational tool.

The system follows one event through Ideate, Comply, Market, and Operate. Its expression can be tactile and assertive, but the product remains source-conscious: verdicts, ruleset snapshots, citations, unknowns, conflicts, and research states keep their hierarchy and never disappear into decoration. Planned capabilities look intentionally provisional and remain disabled.
keyCharacteristics: Printed field-manual materiality rather than generic dashboard chrome.
A federal-blue lifecycle rail anchoring a warm paper work area.
Signal colors assigned to operational meaning, not ambient decoration.
Condensed headlines paired with highly legible body copy and mono provenance.
Hard registration offsets, square rules, and restrained misregistration details.
One responsive system for desktop planning and phone-based field work.

rules.name: The Signal Color Rule
rules.body: Coral marks action or blocked conditions; yellow marks focus, current position, or at-risk state. Do not interchange them for decoration.

rules.name: The Paper Is a Surface Rule
rules.body: Texture may make the canvas tactile, but it never carries meaning or reduces text contrast.

rules.name: The Three-Voice Rule
rules.body: Barlow Condensed carries marks, headlines, and chapters; Public Sans carries sentences and controls; IBM Plex Mono carries evidence and status.

rules.name: The Useful Label Rule
rules.body: Small uppercase mono type must identify real metadata or state, never serve as ornamental eyebrow copy.

rules.name: The One-Event Rail Rule
rules.body: The lifecycle rail orients every organizer task around the same event; attendee and authentication surfaces remain outside it.

rules.name: The Registration, Not Elevation Rule
rules.body: Shadows are short, hard printing offsets. Do not introduce generic soft card shadows into the Riso Field Guide shell.

rules.name: The One Torn Edge Rule
rules.body: Reserve irregular clipping and rotation for clearly planned material; functional regulatory content stays rectilinear and easy to scan.

dos: Do keep federal blue dominant in the organizer shell and reserve signal inks for their assigned operational roles.
Do pair every regulatory decision with its engine-provided provenance and uncertainty state.
Do use the real paper texture as a low-contrast material layer.
Do preserve visible focus, 44px targets, responsive stacking, and reduced-motion behavior.
Do label synthetic data and planned capabilities wherever they could be mistaken for real or shipped behavior.
donts: Don't turn the shell into a generic rounded-card dashboard or add soft ambient elevation.
Don't use tiny mono labels as decorative eyebrows or allow them to become unreadable.
Don't invent regulatory copy, ruleset versions, statuses, metrics, or feature availability for visual effect.
Don't hide unknowns, official conflicts, research-required states, coverage gaps, or partial plans.
Don't apply torn-paper silhouettes to active regulatory content.
